text: Yeddunooɓe Allah fenni Nulaaɓe Makko ɓen wi'oya: Joomi amen, hollii men majjiinooɓe men ɓen ka jinna e ka yimɓe: Ibuliisaa fuɗɗuɗo yeddugol on nodda e mun, e banii-aadama fuɗɗuɗo rufude ƴiiƴam on, men tippa e maɓɓe e nder Yiite, haa ɓe wona e ɓurɓe joltude ɓen ka Yiite, ɓurɓe tiiɗude lepte ɓen.
